title: mmz status
description: Output of `mmz --status=json`: each rule's freshness against its cache.

manifest.description: Path of the manifest governing the working directory.

rules.description: One entry per command rule, in manifest order.

name.description: The rule's name (matcher and cache identity).

state.description: Freshness verdict. `fresh`: cache hit. `stale`: inputs changed. `never`: no record yet. `failed`: last run failed, so it re-runs. `no-inputs`: the rule resolves to zero files.

digest.description: Digest of the current inputs. Absent when the rule resolves to no files.

cached.description: The stored record. Absent when the rule has never run.

digest.description: Input digest recorded at the last run.

inputs.description: Resolved inputs with content hashes, sorted by path.

path.description: Path relative to the manifest root, forward slashes.

hash.description: Lowercase hex blake3 of the file's contents.
